notes: 1.5.0：请配合HA集成0.6.15或更新版本，修复首次点击进度显示并恢复完整镜像写入与校验。0.6.14跳过填充区在实体校验中失败，请勿使用。升级或退出OTA后约1秒开始回报版本；普通上电与每分钟约300ms广播节奏不变。禁用阻塞蓝牙的整包CRC，保留单B分时、手机写值与免按键写值。云端仅OTA，完整恢复包仅本地。
notes_en: 1.5.0: use HA integration 0.6.15 or newer for first-click progress and complete image programming and verification. Do not use 0.6.14: skipped padding failed physical verification. Announce the version about one second after OTA exit; preserve ordinary startup and 300 ms/minute timing. Disable blocking whole-image CRC and retain single-B timing and explicit-click writes. OTA files only; recovery images stay local.
